name: OpenHealthPatient
title: OpenHealth Patient (Nigeria)
description: Patient identity bound to NIMC NIN where available, with a locally-resolvable offline identifier for the unlinked (progressive enrolment).

element.comment: MUST carry either a NIN identifier (system: https://nimc.gov.ng/fhir/NamingSystem/nin) or an offline-resolvable OpenHealth local id (system: https://openhealthos.org/fhir/NamingSystem/offline-id).
Locally-resolvable id issued by the facility edge when NIN is unavailable; reconciled at the state plane on sync.
Phone number enables USSD/SMS eligibility and reminder channels (ADR-0001 fallback).
